rendered.subject: Collaboration Proposal
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting compelling visual narratives for brands. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Stumptown Coffee Roasters, designed to highlight the importance of your Direct Trade relationships [P9]. The post could showcase a curated selection of your coffee beans and the unique experiences offered at Stumptown cafes, encouraging viewers to deepen their connection with the brand [P5]. Together, we could create a visually engaging post that reinforces the value of your dedication to the Direct Trade model.

The BrandPilot team
